Name: Kenneth's Cream Slices
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Adds 10 custom cream slices to Kenneth's Dessert Shop - cherry lattice cream pie slice, layered apple custard pie slice, caramel drizzle chocolate pie slice, classic pumpkin cream pie slice, double layer chocolate cream slice, blueberry topped sponge cake, strawberry topped vanilla cake slice, mixed berry cheesecake slice, black forest cream cake slice, and golden honey sponge cake slice - each with its own cooking recipe and buffs![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Requires Kenneth's Dessert Shop - this mod's items are sold across its shop.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Customization: By default, all cream slices appear in Kenneth's Dessert Shop. If you want to customize your selection and have Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) installed, you can disable individual cream slices to remove them from the shop along with their cooking recipes. Re-enabling a cream slice restores it to the shop and its recipe to your kitchen.[/b][/size]
